Quantinuum has announced the Nexus roadmap, a multi‑year plan aimed at fully automating fault‑tolerant quantum application deployment through 2029. The initiative seeks to streamline the development, testing and production of quantum software that can operate reliably on noisy hardware, positioning Quantinuum as a leader in practical fault‑tolerant quantum computing. Global coverage of the announcement has been aggregated by Google News, underscoring its relevance to the international quantum technology community.
